description: The Industrial Training and Assessment Centers (ITAC) database, formerly the Industrial Assessment Centers database, records the energy, waste and productivity assessments that university-based centres carry out at small and medium-sized US manufacturing plants. At access it held 23,192 assessments and 170,396 recommendations, with facility characteristics such as size, industry by NAICS and SIC code and energy use, and for each recommendation its type, energy savings, cost and implementation status. The programme began in 1976 and is administered by the Office of Manufacturing and Energy Supply Chains at the U.S. Department of Energy. Coverage is national. The database can be searched online and data can be downloaded free; the page read does not state a licence or the download formats. Caveats: plants are anonymised, assessments cover mainly small and medium-sized facilities, and savings are estimates made at the time of assessment. For simulation it provides equipment, energy use and efficiency measures for manufacturing plants, useful for capacity planning and optimisation of industrial energy demand and for estimating how plants respond to energy price or supply shocks. It is related to the DOE Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints record in this catalogue, which gives sector totals.
